fees.notes: Official UNITAR University College Kuala Lumpur (KLMUC) programme listing publishes only 'Local Student' total tuition fees (bachelor's RM30,000-RM48,000; diplomas RM15,000-RM26,154; foundation RM8,000; master's RM12,000-RM25,320; PhD RM29,000-RM39,000). International fees are not published, so left null. Source: https://www.unitar.my/uuckl/programmes/ (checked 2026-09-18).
